name: Ability Damage Resistance
body:
You reduce the amount of ability damage taken.

Benefit: You reduce all ability damage you suffer by 2 points.

Special: The benefit does not apply to any self-induced ability damage, nor does it apply to affects which “reduce” an ability score.
